message:
The other night, as the wind howled outside and the rain pelted the windows like an angry drummer, my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. 
"Do we have candles?" asked my daughter, followed by my son chiming in with, "And what about snacks?" I had to chuckle at the priorities—nothing like a storm to bring out the inner survivalist in us, right? 
We ended up sharing our favorite snack ideas while I made sure the flashlights were charged and the pantry was stocked. 
It’s funny how a little chaos can pull us together, even if it’s just to debate the merits of popcorn versus pretzels. 
What’s your go-to family plan when the weather gets wild?
